spec.claim_summary: Buy bitcoin when trend scores are above 7 and price closes at a 10-day high, exiting when the trend score falls below 5.
spec.untestable_reason: Entry and exit depend on proprietary Bitcoin Trend Score and Relative Trend Score that cannot be expressed with available indicators.

claimed.other: has generated ten buy signals, achieving an average gain of 1436.28% per win, while losses averaged -18.78%

assumptions: NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Bitcoin Trend Score and Bitcoin Relative Trend Score are proprietary scores with no equivalent indicator; entry requirements 'Bitcoin Trend Score > 7' and 'Bitcoin Relative Trend Score > 7' and exit 'Bitcoin Trend Score falls below 5' were left out.
Timeframe not stated in claim; 1d chosen as most natural reading for daily closes and a 10-day high.
Asset Bitcoin interpreted as BTCUSDT spot.
Direction long inferred from buy signals.
'Bitcoin closed at a 10-day high' interpreted as close above the previous 10-bar high: close gt highest_high(10).
Entry requires all three triggers on the same bar; only the expressible 10-day-high leg can be compiled.

evidence.quote: achieving an average gain of 1436.28% per win, while losses averaged -18.78%
